## Baseline Review Evidence

For each baseline review, record the evidence below. Use repository-relative links
where a source exists; do not invent a path or imply unverified currency.

- Baseline view identifier/path: [relative path, or explicitly missing]
- Reviewed at: [timezone-aware date and time, or unknown; request revalidation]
- Reviewer: [identity]; role: [role]; designated architecture owner: [yes/no]
- Relevant source artifacts: [identifier/link and version or revision for each]
- Unknown source version/revision or status: [identify each uncertainty and request
  designated-owner revalidation; do not mark it verified]
- Gap or conflict: [none, or describe it and cite relevant sources; request
  designated-owner review/revalidation]
- Missing-baseline owner disposition: [pending / relevant / not relevant]
- Missing-baseline follow-up and rationale: [owner-determined action and reason]

While a missing-baseline disposition is pending, assert neither relevance nor a
baseline link. Do not fabricate a link. Record uncertainty about an unknown review
point or source status and request revalidation rather than claiming the baseline
is current or aligned.
